attrs.text: LEAKY INTEGRATE-AND-FIRE NEURON   V' = V - (V >> s) + I    spike when V >= T
INPUTS (DIP switches)   1-5: current I (0-31)   6: leak 0=slow(V>>5) 1=fast(V>>3)   7-8: threshold 64/96/128/192
OUTPUTS   7-seg: level meter of V vs threshold, DP = spike   bar graph: V in binary   analyzers: V bus + spike
WIRE COLOURS   blue = clock   orange = reset / hold   green = V bits   cyan = leak (V>>s)   purple = carries
gold = input current I   limegreen = partial sums   gray = V' feedback   magenta = threshold   red = spike   white = display
7-SEG LEVEL METER: fills bottom-up as V nears T
